Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL3436043. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno as an inner join. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL3436043, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
